Zirgozar now follows the active LuCI theme's colours and component styling. Argon, Material, Material3 and Aurora have been checked on the router, including mobile layouts. The independent light and dark appearances remain available.

- Match cards, buttons, inputs, tabs and dialogs to the host theme.
- Follow light and dark changes, including Aurora's modern colour formats.
- Clear application styling when leaving Zirgozar through Aurora's page navigation.
- Fix excessive spacing in mobile forms.
- Keep Material's tables and tabbed forms dark when using Zirgozar's independent dark appearance, and improve description and placeholder contrast.

Mobile checks covered native light/dark appearances in Argon, Material3 and Aurora. Material was checked in its native light appearance and Zirgozar's independent dark appearance; this Material package has no native dark switch.

ظاهر زیرگذر با تم‌های Argon، Material، Material3 و Aurora هماهنگ می‌شود. برای استفاده، «پیروی از تم LuCI» را در زیرگذر انتخاب کنید.

Install the matching core and LuCI packages: APK for OpenWrt 25.12+, IPK for OpenWrt 23.05–24.10. Choose the core package matching `DISTRIB_ARCH` in `/etc/openwrt_release`.
